input:
Edge case: CoreSight ETR is configured but the system has only 1MB of DRAM available for trace (extreme low-memory device). The recommended ETR buffer is 16-32MB.

Is ETR usable with 1MB? What is the worst-case trace overrun behavior? Should we fall back to ETF-only configuration (64KB on-chip), and what trace-capture-window length does that limit us to under typical CPU instruction rate?

Walk through the math: at 2GHz CPU, ~3 IPC, 1 byte per instruction encoded ETM4 trace, what trace-window does 64KB ETF buffer?
